title: service-automation: the connector pull door (connectorSource.input) still sends input keys the connector action does not declare, while connector_action refuses them
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Split out of #33663 (PR #33886, os-dev report 6895169251 on #33663, which has the four-axis analysis). It carries its own Clause-② answer, so it is not folded into #33886. p3.

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：连接器拉取入口（映射里的 `connectorSource.input`）也像 `connector_action` 节点一样，拒收连接器动作未声明的输入键，而不是静默发出去。
- 为什么：自 #33614 起，同一份 inputSchema 在两个入口上判法不同；AI 写错或过时的键在拉取入口不会报错。
- 风险：收窄；实测第一方 0 处受影响（examples/、packages/apps/ 无 connectorSource，Studio 不写它）。

## What

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`: opt `connectorSource.input` into the undeclared-key judge (`judgeConnectorInput(..., { refuseUndeclaredKeys: true })`), with the pull door's own hint.
- Flip the pin `[#33553] an undeclared key is not refused here` in `connector-pull.test.ts` to a refusal pin (`code` + `status`: `VALIDATION_ERROR` 400, handler never called), and ablate it.
- Declaration (expected): `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `minor` on service-automation, an ADR-0087 disposition. Widen the semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.connector-action-undeclared-input-key-refused.ts` (its surface and acceptance criteria name connector_action only), or add a new entry. The 18.5.0 CHANGELOG already carries the connector_action half, so this gets its own breaking note.

Dedupe words: `connector pull undeclared input key`, `connectorSource.input refuseUndeclaredKeys`.
